zone_name: The Big Green EXIT (stair bait, dead end)
name: The Big Green EXIT (Clock Edition)
read_aloud: EXIT. A marked stairwell sign is ahead, with a countdown. Audio: birds. There are no birds on this floor.
narrator_line: EXIT. A marked stairwell sign is ahead, with a countdown.
layout: A short stair down from a side passage ends at a landing with alcoves on both sides and a floor that is not a floor.

exits.name: Back up the stair to the Break Room.
The left alcove hides the Back Office door (found when the Greeters are gone, see 00-overview.md section 5.7).
No other exit; it is a dead end.

features.name: Alcove frames and clipboard stands (half cover).
Trapdoor over a pit with broken glass (T4, check values in 00-overview.md section 5.7).
Birdsong speaker and fan that make the sign convincing.

enemies.note: spoken_name is the live Day-page name. stat_card is the SRD body in this pack. Dean Thudd is not renamed.
spoken_name is the live Day-page name. stat_card is the SRD body in this pack. Dean Thudd is not renamed.

quick_run.setup: A short stair ends at a landing with a floor that is not a floor, and goblin greeters wait on it.
quick_run.decision: Charge the greeters, or look for a way past the false stairs?
quick_run.on_success: The greeters fall or are bypassed and the Back Office gear is theirs.
quick_run.on_failure: A Crawler drops into the pit and the greeters press from above.
quick_run.cut_short: Run one round of landing combat and one check for the trapdoor; skip the alcoves.

loot.text: Greeters' Back Office cache (Jug O' Boom recipe card, goblin oil, worn Tinker's Tools). Not a box and not a permanent magic item.

gm_notes: Strong-model notes stay on the Day page. This stub does not copy if_they_do_something_dumb.
